source_evidence: Many employers match contributions you make up to a certain amount.
answer: A workplace retirement account, such as a 401(k), 403(b), or 457(b), is a retirement plan offered through many jobs. Contributions may reduce the amount of taxes you pay, and some employers match contributions up to a limit. The plan will offer investment choices for the money contributed by you and your employer. Annual contribution limits apply. The source suggests considering contributions up to the amount your employer matches so you can use the matching funds available.
